documento.plantilla_tamano: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
documento.plantilla_marcadores: The template was not saved. Check the listed markers. If no details are shown, check that it is a Word file without macros or active content.
documento.plantilla_antivirus: The template cannot be published until the antivirus is available and completes its scan.
documento.plantilla_infectada: The antivirus detected an infection. The template was not published.
documento.plantilla_version_usada: This version already exists. Choose a new version number.
documento.plantilla_conflicto: Someone else activated a version. Refresh the list and review the active version before confirming again.
plantillas.ayuda_texto: Each document has a template for each language. Upload a Word file with the same markers as the active version. Markers identify the data filled in when a document is generated. Uploading saves a new version; activate it when you want to start using it. You can return to a previous version without deleting its history.
plantillas.revisando: Scanning the file for viruses and checking its markers…
plantillas.no_disponible: We could not complete the operation. Refresh the list to check its status before trying again.
plantillas.subida: Version saved. It passed the virus scan and marker checks. It is waiting to be activated.
plantillas.activada: Version activated. New documents will use this template.
plantillas.formato_version: Enter three numbers separated by dots, such as 2.0.0.
plantillas.politica: Word (.docx), up to 10 MB. It must pass the virus scan and keep the active version’s markers.
plantillas.vacio: No templates are available. Ask IT to install the initial templates.
plantillas.activacion_inicial: Initially installed version. Its activation date and author were not recorded.
plantillas.antivirus_no_consta: No virus scan was recorded for this initial version
plantillas.confirmar_consecuencia: New documents will use this version. Documents already issued will keep their previous template. The activation will be recorded with your name and the date.
plantillas.falta_archivo: Choose a file and its document type.
plantillas.archivo_invalido: Choose a non-empty Word (.docx) file of up to 10 MB.
plantillas.version_invalida: Enter three numbers separated by dots, such as 2.0.0.
plantillas.marcador_falta: Marker “{valor}” is missing. Add it to the Word file before uploading again.
plantillas.marcador_sobra: Marker “{valor}” is unexpected. Remove or correct it before uploading the Word file again.

plantillas.tipo.salida.spm.anexo5: Annex 5 · Referral to the Child Protection Service
plantillas.peticion_invalida: Check the document, language and version before trying again.
plantillas.acceso_denegado: You do not have permission to manage templates. Sign in with an Administration role.
plantillas.alterada: The saved file has changed. It was not activated. Ask IT to check this version.
